questions.stem: In Practice Exam (Topic 1), identify the French anatomist who defined 21 primary tissue types without microscopic aid:
questions.explanation: Xavier Bichat coined the term tissue and defined 21 primary tissue classes.

questions.stem: In Practice Exam (Topic 1), microscopic investigation of animal tissues was systematically pioneered by which biologist?
In Practice Exam (Topic 1), true tissue level of organization first evolved in which invertebrate phylum?
questions.explanation: Tissue grade organization originated in Coelenterates (Hydra).

questions.stem: In Practice Exam (Topic 1), embryonic mesoderm gives origin to which pair of primary tissues?
questions.explanation: Connective tissue and muscle arise from embryonic mesoderm.

questions.stem: In Practice Exam (Topic 1), which primary tissue type originates from all three germ layers (Ectoderm, Mesoderm, Endoderm)?
questions.explanation: Epithelia derive from ectoderm, mesoderm, and endoderm.

questions.stem: In Practice Exam (Topic 1), the non-cellular basement membrane underlying epithelial sheets contains basal lamina and:
questions.explanation: Basement membrane = Basal lamina + Reticular lamina.

questions.stem: In Practice Exam (Topic 1), avascular epithelial sheets obtain metabolic nutrients primarily via:
options: A) Direct intra-epithelial capillary blood flow
B) Simple diffusion from underlying connective tissue blood vessels
C) Active transport from lumen air space
questions.answer: B) Simple diffusion from underlying connective tissue blood vessels
questions.explanation: Epithelial cells depend on nutrient diffusion across the basement membrane.

questions.stem: In Practice Exam (Topic 1 - MSQ), select all historical milestones established in animal histology: (Select all that apply)
options: A) Xavier Bichat defined 21 primary tissue types without microscope
B) Marcello Malpighi pioneered microscopic tissue investigation
C) Mayer coined the term 'Histology' in 1819
D) True tissue level first evolved in Phylum Coelenterata
answers: A) Xavier Bichat defined 21 primary tissue types without microscope
B) Marcello Malpighi pioneered microscopic tissue investigation
C) Mayer coined the term 'Histology' in 1819
D) True tissue level first evolved in Phylum Coelenterata
questions.explanation: Bichat, Malpighi, Mayer, and Coelenterate evolution represent foundational histology milestones.

questions.stem: In Practice Exam (Topic 1 - MSQ), select all primary tissue classes in complex animals: (Select all that apply)
options: E) Vascular Tissue as fifth primary class
questions.explanation: 4 primary tissues: Epithelial, Connective, Muscular, Nervous.

questions.stem: In Practice Exam (Topic 1 - MSQ), select all embryonic germ layers giving rise to Epithelial Tissues: (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: Epithelium arises from Ectoderm, Mesoderm, and Endoderm.
